name: Ore Doubling
description: Crushing gets more metal out of an ore block than smelting it does.

pages.title: Ore Doubling
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Crush **ore blocks** (mined with Silk Touch): about 1.75 crushed ores each, 2.25 from deepslate
- **Raw ore** crushes to just one: no gain
- Then smelt the crushed ore, or [#](7A3C9A)[wash](entry://glossary/washing)[#]() it with a Fan for nuggets

Crushing gets more metal out of an ore block than smelting it does. This is the main reason to build [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing Wheels](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]().\
\
One ore block gives 1 crushed ore, a 75%% chance of a second, experience nuggets and sometimes stone back.

pages.title: Crushing Wheel
pages.text: Feed it ore blocks (mine them with Silk Touch). About 1.75 crushed ores per block, and 2.25 for deepslate ore.

pages.title: Raw versus block
pages.text:
The catch: **raw ore**, what normal mining drops, crushes to one crushed ore. No gain. Only the ore block itself doubles.\
\
Then smelt or wash the crushed ore.
Ore blocks from Silk Touch double; raw ore doesn't.

pages.title: Crushed Raw Iron
pages.text: Blast it into one ingot, or wash it with a Fan into nuggets plus a chance at a byproduct. Crushed zinc works the same.
Washing: 9 nuggets and a chance of a byproduct (see JEI). Blasting: one ingot.

pages.title: Fan washing
pages.text: Washing means a [#](2E5AAC)[Fan](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() blowing through water. Iron gives 9 nuggets and may add redstone. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for each metal's byproduct.

pages.title: Which metals
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Create covers copper, iron, gold and zinc. [#](7A3C9A)[Tag](entry://glossary/tags)[#]() recipes also cover platinum, uranium, nickel and raw lead when a mod supplies them. Its recipe for lead ore blocks is off.

pages.title: Add-on crushing
pages.text:
- [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#](): nickel, lithium, bauxite to powder, galena to a little lead. Its metals get a smaller bonus, about 1.25.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Create Nuclear](entry://industry/nuclear)[#](): crushed uranium to powder, thorium, nitrate.

pages.title: Crushed Raw Lithium
pages.text: TFMG's lithium ore crushes to this, then blasts to an ingot. Nickel ore crushes to [Crushed Raw Nickel](item://create:crushed_raw_nickel).

pages.title: More metals
pages.text:
- Create Propulsion adds platinum, Iron's Spells mithril.
- **Northstar** planet ores crush at the full rate into raw items, for example raw titanium. Raw titanium smelts straight to an ingot.
- Venus coal ore crushes to extra coal.

pages.title: Raw Titanium
pages.text: Crush any planet's titanium ore for about 1.75 of these, then smelt or blast. [#](2E5AAC)[Planets](entry://space/planets)[#]()

pages.title: Other mods
pages.text:
Aether zanite and ambrosium ores give 1.75 gems or shards each.\
\
No crushing recipes exist for Alex's Caves, Better End or Twilight Forest ores; smelt them as normal.
